create_TrackDataPreprocessor: create a TrackDataPreprocessor instance with mean, std, and pad_size_divisor for video tracking data preprocessing
run_TrackDataPreprocessor_forward: run the TrackDataPreprocessor forward pass to normalize, pad, and stack batch sequence images for tracking models
build_stack_track_batch: build a batch of padded sequence images by stacking TCHW tensors into an NTCHW 5D tensor with right bottom padding
review_TrackDataPreprocessor_init: review the TrackDataPreprocessor constructor to configure mean/std buffers and use_det_processor flag for training mode
test_pad_track_gt_masks: test the pad_track_gt_masks method to pad ground truth instance masks to match batch input shape
